enc.row.d: Your photos are readable by anyone who plugs in the disk. Encrypt them with your ALP password.
enc.1.title: Encrypt this ALPArchive?
enc.1.a: The stick and your photos get locked with your ALP password.
enc.1.b: The backup disk needs {room} more free room for a while: the photos are copied, checked, then the open copy is deleted.
enc.1.c: Phones stop backing up until it is done. It can take hours for many photos.
enc.1.d: If the power goes off, it continues at the next start once you type the password.
enc.1.e: Files written before may still be readable from the stick's chips and the disk. For full protection use a new stick and a freshly formatted disk.
enc.2.title: Your ALP password
enc.2.sub: It will lock everything. If you forget it, nobody can open your photos.

enc.3.sub: When the encrypted copy is checked, the open copy on the backup disk is deleted.

enc.run.sub: Keep the computer on. Phones resume when it is done.
enc.done: Everything is encrypted now. Phones sign in with your ALP password.

import.known: {n} of these are already in your archive and will be skipped.
import.more: There is more here than can be shown. Import the whole folder to bring in everything.
import.keepworking: You can keep using ALPArchive. The progress shows at the top.
import.done: {photos} photos and {videos} videos imported. {known} were already in your archive.
import.ejected: You can unplug the disk now.
import.found.sub: Import them into your archive? Nothing on the disk is changed.
fmt.secure.d: Overwrites the whole disk so old files are very hard to recover. About {n} minutes.
fmt.label: Name for the disk (optional)
fmt.label.bad: A disk name has up to 11 letters, numbers, spaces, - or _.
fmt.danger.title: Erase {name}?
fmt.warn.bitlocker: BitLocker data. It is lost for good.
fmt.warn.windows: A system that can start a computer (for example Windows).
fmt.warn.alparchive_folder: An ALPArchive folder, perhaps another stick's archive.
fmt.run.title: Formatting {name}
fmt.stop.note: Stopping a secure format leaves the disk partly wiped and without a file system; format it again to use it.
fmt.refused: This disk cannot be formatted here. The reason is under (i).
reset.run.title: Erasing your archive
reset.run.sub: This can take a while on a big stick. Do not unplug anything.
gallery.url.bad: Photos could not open: the photo address from the server looks wrong. Please save a report and send it to us.
set.files.d: Look at the files on a USB stick, memory card or disk. Nothing on it is changed.
files.ro: Read only. Nothing on these disks can be changed here.
files.none: No disk to look at yet.
files.skipped: {n} names could not be shown because they use letters this screen cannot read.
files.noopen: This kind of file cannot be opened here. Photos, videos and text files can.
files.unreadable: This file could not be opened. It may be damaged, or of a kind this screen cannot show.
files.text.cut: Only the beginning of this file is shown.
disks.refused.empty: No partitions were found on this disk, so it cannot be formatted here yet. Unplug it and plug it in again.
fmt.time.about: Takes about {n} minutes on this disk.
set.term.d: A text console for support and advanced users. It cannot change the system or reach your archive.
term.pw: Your password to open the Terminal
term.logged: Commands you run here are kept in the system log. The Terminal closes when the screen locks after 5 minutes without use.
term.url.bad: The Terminal could not open: the address from the server looks wrong. Please save a report and send it to us.
term.ended.d: It closes when the screen locks after 5 minutes without use. Typing in the Terminal does not keep the screen awake. Open it again from Settings.
err.terminal.no_password: The Terminal needs an ALPArchive password, and this computer has none yet. Set one first, then open the Terminal again.
set.size.d: Makes everything on this screen bigger or smaller.
set.res.d: How sharp the picture is. The recommended choice fits this screen.
disp.keep.title: Keep this resolution?
disp.keep.left: Going back to the old one in {n} seconds.
set.homebg.d: The picture behind the home screen. More choices are coming.
crit.bar: Stop: don't use your archive until this is fixed.
crit.paused: Importing, deleting and phone backup are paused to keep your photos safe. You can still look at your photos, and prepare a new disk.
hw.net.wifi.sub: A network cable is even faster and steadier, if you have one.
hw.net.cable: Connected with a cable. Best choice.
hw.net.none: No network yet. A network cable also works.
disks.internal.line: This computer's own disk. ALPArchive Live never touches it, to keep your data intact.
disks.internal.tech: Live sets this disk read-only at start-up. The full installation of ALPArchive will be able to use it.
disks.lock.startover: To erase this disk, use Start over in Advanced.
disks.lock.wp: This disk is write-protected. Slide its lock switch, then plug it in again.
disks.lock.open: Files from this disk are open. Close them first.
disks.lock.other: This disk cannot be erased here.
disks.none.open: Plug in a disk to see it here.
disks.checking: Checking the disk. Nothing on it is changed.
fmt.title.name: Format {name}
fmt.fs.exfat.d: Recommended for portable disks and cameras.
fmt.fs.ext4.d: Windows and Mac computers cannot read it without extra software.
fmt.lose.photos: {n} photos here are not in your archive yet.
fmt.stale: The disk changed since you looked at it. Please check it again.
fmt.warn.system: A system that starts a computer. That computer may not start any more.
fmt.rescue: Use this to prepare a new disk for your archive.
crit.paused.what.import: Importing is paused until the problem is fixed
crit.paused.what.delete: Deleting is paused until the problem is fixed
